title: Andika icyemezo
intro: Hitamo igisubizo kimwe. Icyemezo cyawe cyandikwa n'izina ryawe, inshingano, ikigo n'igihe, kandi ntigishobora guhindurwa nyuma yo kubikwa.

no_further_action.label: Andika isuzuma — nta kindi gikorwa
no_further_action.description: Andika inyandiko y'isuzuma ryawe. Nta koherezwa cyangwa umurimo bikorwa.

refer.label: Ohereza
refer.description: Kora iyoherezwa ku kigo uhisemo, ufite impamvu n'itariki ntarengwa.

request_repeat_screening.label: Saba kongera gupima
request_repeat_screening.description: Kora umurimo wo kongera gupima uhabwa umujyanama w'ubuzima w'iki kigo.

plan_follow_up.label: Teganya isuzuma rikurikira
plan_follow_up.description: Kora umurimo w'isuzuma riteganyijwe ufite itariki ntarengwa ushyizeho.

dismiss.label: Kuraho ikimenyetso ufite impamvu
dismiss.description: Funga ikimenyetso ufite impamvu. Nta kindi gikorwa.

fields.dueAtHint: Bishyirwaho nawe — nta gihe cyerekanwa. Isaha ya Africa/Kigali.
fields.workersLoading: Abajyanama b'ubuzima b'iki kigo bari gufungurwa…
fields.workersEmpty: Nta mujyanama w'ubuzima wemewe uri muri iki kigo.
fields.workersHint: Hagaragara gusa abajyanama b'ubuzima bemewe b'ikigo gikora ubu.

summary.createsNothing: Nta kindi — nta koherezwa cyangwa umurimo

success.title: Icyemezo cyanditswe
success.replayed: Iki cyemezo cyari cyarabitswe — nticyoherejwe kabiri.
success.alreadyBody: Ibyemezo ntibihindurwa. Icyemezo cyanditswe kigaragazwa gusomwa gusa.
success.noNextCase: Nta kindi kibazo gitegereje muri uru rutonde.

draft.restoreBody: Umushinga w'icyemezo cy'iri suzuma wabitswe kuri iyi mashakisha ariko ntiwoherejwe.
draft.offlineBody: Interineti yigana yavuyeho — icyemezo ntigishobora kubikwa ubu. Umushinga wawe urabitswe.

guard.notStarted: Banza utangire isuzuma mbere yo kwandika icyemezo
guard.notStartedBody: Icyemezo cyandikwa gusa ku isuzuma watangiye.
guard.otherReviewerBody: Umuganga uri gusuzuma ikibazo ni we wenyine wandika icyemezo.

conflict.title: Iri suzuma ryahindutse kuva warifungura
conflict.description: Nta cyabitswe cyangwa ngo gisimburwe. Ongera ufungure verisiyo iheruka, cyangwa usibe umushinga wawe.
conflict.referralOpen: Hari iyoherezwa rifunguye risanzweho kuri iri suzuma. Nta cyabitswe.

errors.alreadyDecided: Icyemezo cy'iri suzuma cyari cyaranditswe (urugero mu yindi tabu). Nta cyasimbuwe.
errors.notSavedBody: Ibyo wanditse birabitswe. Kongera kugerageza byohereza icyifuzo kimwe, bityo icyemezo ntigishobora kubikwa kabiri.
errors.workerNotAuthorised: Uyu mujyanama w'ubuzima ntiyemerewe muri iki kigo.
